name: 3D Coordinate Packing
definition: Packs three 16-bit voxel coordinates (x, y, z) into a single 64-bit integer key for hash map indexing.
summary: 3D Coordinate Packing converts three 16-bit voxel coordinates into a single 64-bit integer key using fixed bit-width allocations, offering faster performance than space-filling curves but lacking spatial locality.
